research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess split conformal prediction under controlled changes in covariate distributions for regression tasks.
Compared unweighted and importance-weighted calibration procedures, examining empirical coverage, interval width, and sensitivity to estimated density ratios.

research.title: Probability Calibration for Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to isolate effects of class imbalance and calibration sample size on predicted probability reliability.
Evaluated logistic regression and tree ensembles using held-out calibration sets, reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and repeated stratified data splits.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate identifiers before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for parsing and transformation routines, reproduced reported failures, and documented expected behavior for malformed input records.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors and cross-validation for selecting regularization strength on synthetic and tabular datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, using repeated splits to examine sensitivity to training sample composition.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Models for Cluster Recovery
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance structures, including convergence checks and repeated initialization.
Compared mixture models with k-means on synthetic clusters, evaluating cluster recovery and held-out likelihood under varying overlap and covariance geometry.
